title: Repeating field
description: Best-practice rule — flags fields with more than one repetition. Repeating fields are hard to query and report on; a related table is usually better.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Repeating fields resist normalisation, reporting and relationships.
rule.remediation: Model the repetitions as related records in a child table.
